verdict.rationale: Brex ships AI features such as an AI-powered expense assistant, so asking whether its AI can connect to external MCP servers is a fair question. However, the evidence documents only Brex's own MCP server, which lets outside AI assistants act on a Brex account. That is the server role, a different story. Nothing shows Brex acting as an MCP client that can plug in third-party MCP servers and use their tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
